This is why Common is the overwhelming majority, and why nothing about the classification is visible from outside it. The boundary gets crossed by ordinary people marrying ordinary people, usually without anybody in the room knowing a boundary was there.

HVIT MEANS THE WHITE MOON, NOT ONLY THE FIRST WOMAN. The rule that a child of the Nine is Founding only through Hvit is not a statement about one woman in the eleventh century. Doctrine holds that a White Moon is Hvit returned and that there is only ever one alive at a time, so the rule reads as it has always been applied in practice: the Nine plus the White Moon of that age.

What follows is that a new first-generation Founding line can begin only in the years when a White Moon is alive and pairs with one of the Nine, which across a millennium has happened a handful of times. Nixara Bloodmoon was the most recent, born in 1975 to Wulfnic and the White Moon who came before her, and she died in 2005.

This does not mean Founding blood ended with her. Her children are second generation, and their children will be Founding whoever they marry, because the two-generation rule carries them; it is the generation after that which drops to Pureblood. What ended in 2005 was the beginning of anything new, and that can only resume while a White Moon is alive.

A GENERATION IS NOT A DATE. Generation count measures steps away from the Nine and has very little to do with when a wolf was born. Two people standing in the same room can be second generation and sixtieth, and the second-generation one can easily be the younger of the two by a thousand years.

The reason is that one end of every chain never dies. Wulfnic Bloodmoon has been fertile for twelve centuries, cycles like any Alpha, and has never been a careful man about it. The lines he began on arriving in North America in 1020 have been turning over roughly every twenty years since and now stand at fifty or sixty generations. That is why there is a werewolf population on this continent at all, and why almost every wolf in it is Common. Meanwhile his daughter Nixara was born in 1975, which makes her children second generation, born a thousand years after the lines that started with their great-grandfather's first season here.

Two things follow that matter in play. First, closeness to the Nine is not a claim about antiquity. A second-generation wolf is not an old family, he is a short chain, and he may well be twenty-eight years old. Second, the overwhelming majority of what Wulfnic fathered was Pureblood rather than Founding, because the inheritance rules make a child of the Nine Founding only through Hvit; everything else began one rung down and has been descending ever since. This is the arithmetic that makes Founding lines almost impossibly rare while making Wulfnic the ancestor of very nearly everyone.

Blood Classification therefore does not describe different kinds of werewolf. It describes DISTANCE FROM THE ORIGIN, and that distance is produced by one mechanism: dilution through breeding outside the line, with humans and with other races. The more generations of outside blood a line has taken in, the weaker the inheritance expresses.

- Founding Bloodlines are direct descendants of the Nine. Their blood is still strong because the line has stayed close to its source.
- Pureblood Houses arise two ways: as the direct children of the Nine by mothers of other races, and as Founding lines that have dropped past the third generation of outside marriage. Their blood is diluting generation by generation, but house structure and selective marriage slow the process considerably.
- Common Bloodlines are the furthest from the primary line, the accumulated result of many generations of outside breeding. They are not a lesser species; they are the same species at greater remove from its origin.

This is why bloodline politics matter so intensely to the Houses: every marriage outside the line is, biologically, a decision about how much of the origin the next generation will carry.

A note on the Living Sagas: that Wulfnic, Ut and Zefir remained together across eleven centuries is pure chance, not design. The Nine did not stay as a group. They scattered, founded separate lines in different parts of the world, and the three survivors simply happened to end up in the same place. The Bloodmoon Longhouse is an accident of history that the faithful have since read as providence.

DIVINE BLOOD: the Nine Firstborn. According to the Faith of Fenris, created directly by the First Wolf; Recorded History confirms their existence but not the mechanism of origin. Traits: biological immortality, extreme regeneration, perfect transformation stability, supreme pheromonal aura, absolute Command.

FOUNDING BLOODLINES: direct children and grandchildren of the Firstborn, founders of the Great Houses. Traits: exceptionally long lifespan, high genetic stability, strong Command affinity, enhanced regeneration.

PUREBLOOD HOUSES: multi-generational descendants of Founding Bloodlines, the aristocracy. Traits: long lifespan, stable genetics, reliable secondary sex expression, strong pack bonds.

COMMON BLOODLINES: the vast majority of the werewolf population. Standard werewolf biology, strength and abilities within normal species range. Their lifespan is the human lifespan or a little under it: a Common Bloodline werewolf who reaches eighty has done well, and most do not. Two reasons, and they compound. They run hot, biologically, and burn through a life faster than a human does. And they are an aggressive species living in a world that has not stopped being dangerous to them, so the average is dragged down by conflict, by fights, and by deaths that had nothing to do with biology. The old joke about dog years is not a joke to anyone who has buried a packmate at sixty.

MODIFIED LINEAGES: individuals whose genetics have been artificially altered through experimentation, forced transformation, or technological intervention (e.g. Gamma-7 program subjects). Unpredictable traits: may include enhanced abilities, instability, feral tendencies, or shortened lifespan.

Lifespan by classification: Common Bloodlines ~60-80 years, at or slightly below the human average. Pureblood Houses ~200-400 years. Founding Bloodlines may exceed 500 years. Divine Blood individuals have achieved biological immortality (1000+ years confirmed).

THE GAP IS THE POINT. The jump from Common to Pureblood is not a step, it is a different order of existence: roughly seventy years against two hundred and more. This is the single most important social fact about blood classification, and it is why the Houses are what they are. A Pureblood lord watches four or five generations of Common families live and die inside his own adulthood. A Common werewolf who deals with a House deals with people who will still be there long after everyone he knows is gone, and knows it. Every Common Bloodline character in this world is, from the point of view of the Houses, temporary, and every Common Bloodline character knows how the Houses see them.

Most werewolves anyone meets in Solarton or Blackwood are Common Bloodline, and live an ordinary human span. The centuries belong to a handful of families and to three old men in a longhouse.

APPARENT AGE. Common Bloodlines age on a human schedule and die on a human schedule, but they do not look it. The species runs fitter and stronger than a human at every point of the curve, and the wear shows late. Growth is human-normal to about twenty-five; after that, visible aging runs at roughly one apparent year for every five lived. A Common of fifty reads as a man of thirty. At sixty he reads as a man in his early thirties, at seventy barely past that, and then in the last few years the gap closes almost at once: he greys, thins out and fails inside a handful of seasons instead of declining across two decades. This is the short lifespan seen from the other side. They run hot, they hold the shape of their prime nearly to the end, and then they burn out.

The practical consequence, for anyone reading a room: apparent youth says nothing about blood. A werewolf who looks thirty may be a Common of fifty with fifteen years left, a Pureblood of two hundred, or one of the Nine. Age is read from bearing, from scent, and from what someone has lived through, never from the face. Common Bloodlines know their own markers and read each other accurately; humans and outsiders guess wrong in both directions, and usually guess young.

At the far end of the scale the rule inverts, and then breaks. Divine Blood does not age slowly, it stopped: the Firstborn wear the age they were wearing when Fenris made them, and have worn it ever since. Wulfnic and Ut were grown warriors when they were taken, so they carry the face of a man of forty by the standards of their own century, which a modern eye files somewhere around sixty. Zefir was not. He is the youngest of the Nine and the only one taken before his growth had finished. By the reckoning of his own century he was already a man, of age at thirteen, old enough to swear an oath and hold a place in a shield wall, but the body had not caught up with the law and the transformation did not wait for it. Eleven centuries later it still has not caught up. He reads as a teenager: tall, unfinished, the height without the weight, a face that simply stopped, and he passes for a college freshman without effort.

So the face is useless at both ends. A Common looks twenty years younger than he is. A Firstborn looks a thousand years younger than he is. The boy in the hoodie at the back of the lecture hall may be the oldest thing in the building.

THE LAST GENERATION THAT IS CERTAIN. The inheritance rules have a consequence that matters right now, in this house, and not in the abstract. Wulfnic is Divine Blood. Nixara, his daughter, was Founding of the first generation. Her four children, Malachia, Noah, Jasper and Alyssa, are Founding of the second. A Founding line survives marriage into a Pureblood house for two generations, so the children of those four will still be Founding whoever they marry. Their grandchildren will not: those are the third generation, and third generation crossed with Pureblood drops to Pureblood, and does not come back.

So the four of them are the last generation of this line whose children are guaranteed Founding regardless of partner. It is arithmetic, available to anyone who knows the rules, and it sits under every conversation about who they marry whether or not anybody says it out loud.

UN'ALTRA COSA CHE LA CLASSIFICAZIONE DECIDE: chi deve presentarsi. La legge del diciannovesimo anno, il raduno in cui un'Omega incontra i propri pretendenti, vale solo per Founding e Pureblood. Per i Common non esiste: non vengono presentati, non devono un appuntamento ne' un fidanzamento a nessuno, e formano coppie secondo gli usi del posto in cui sono cresciuti invece che secondo una legge continentale. Poiche' i Common sono la stragrande maggioranza, l'istituzione piu' importante nella vita affettiva delle Case e' un'usanza che quasi nessun licantropo incontrera' mai. Vedi "La Legge di Wulfnic: il diciannovesimo anno".
lexicon.name: LSE Blood Classification

lexicon.content:
Lupine Social Ecology, module Behavioral Ecology: child-rearing and the transition to adulthood.

ALLOPARENTING: pups are raised communally, not solely by biological parents. Role tendencies by secondary sex: Alphas/Enigmas often take a protective/disciplinary role and handle safety training, Betas provide steady day-to-day caretaking and practical teaching, Deltas mediate conflicts between pups and smooth social friction, Omegas often provide emotional nurturing, comfort, and nest/home-based care. Any pack adult may fill any role as needed; these are tendencies, not assignments (biology is not destiny, per LSE Core Principles).

SUCCESSION, "THE CALL OF THE PACK": around ages 18-22, young werewolves face a pull to either Stay (remain with their birth pack, take up a role within it) or Disperse (leave to found or join another pack, driven by instinct as much as choice). This is described in-universe as an actual felt pull, not just a social custom, tied to hormonal/instinctual maturation. Disperse is not a rejection of family and Stay is not a lack of ambition; both are normal, socially accepted paths. A character who is at, near, or past this age window may reference having felt or resolved this pull.

Applies as background for any Douglas/Bloodmoon-adjacent young adult character (e.g. Noah, Jasper) and any pack NPC in that age range.
lexicon.name: LSE Alloparenting & Succession (The Call of the Pack)
lexicon.comment: LSE Alloparenting & Succession (The Call of the Pack)

lexicon.content:
Wulfnic nacque nell'827 d.C. Dopo la Guerra di Fenris e l'esilio del clan Svartúlfr, guidò un viaggio di circa 12.962 km lungo le rotte artiche e costiere, durato circa sette mesi a una velocità media di 17 nodi.

Sbarcò in California intorno al 1022 d.C. e vi fondò la prima Bloodmoon Longhouse, piantando un germoglio di tasso portato con sé dall'Islanda, lo stesso albero da cui deriva il nome originario del fiume Yarrow (Ýrá, "fiume del tasso" in norreno antico).

Nel 2026, Wulfnic ha circa 1199 anni.

lexicon.content:
HOUSE GENEALOGIES SUMMARY (Appendix H)

This is a summary reference only; detailed per-character information lives on each character's own card.

HOUSE DOUGLAS (Pureblood)
House Color Traits: black hair, amber eyes. A Pureblood House of the werewolf aristocracy; multi-generational descendants of Founding Bloodlines with long lifespans, stable genetics, and strong pack bonds. The house descends from an English ducal line: Cornelius was a younger son with no prospect of inheriting, which is what sent him to the colonies.
- Lord Cornelius Douglas (deceased): Pureblood, Prime Alpha. Born August 14, 1631 in England, died November 3, 1856 at 225. Founder of House Douglas and Governor of the Blackwood Colony from 1666. Founded the Douglas Commercial Company as a chartered colonial venture with its own naval fleet.
- Magnus Douglas III: Pureblood, Alpha, 357. Born December 29, 1668 in the Blackwood Colony. Cornelius's firstborn and heir; inherited House Douglas in 1856 at 187 and converted the colonial company into a modern import/export house. He is still the House Head. Father of Erik and Logan. Named for the English ducal line: his great-grandfather Magnus I holds the duchy, and Cornelius's elder brother Magnus II is its heir.
- Erik Douglas: Pureblood, Prime Alpha, 55. Born October 31, 1969. Patriarch of House Douglas and Pack Leader of the Seven Hills Pack, CEO of the DCC. The House Head is still his father Magnus, and the two offices being held by different men is the uncommon case the Patriarch entry describes. Widower of Nixara Bloodmoon.
- Logan Douglas: Pureblood, Prime Beta, 49. Born January 12, 1975. Erik's younger brother. Owner of The Verve.
- Edric Douglas: Pureblood, Gamma (unpresented). Logan's son, raised at the garage in Seven Hills.

HOUSE BLOODMOON (Divine Blood / Founding Bloodline)
House Color Traits: blond hair, blue eyes. The most ancient werewolf dynasty in North America, founded by Wulfnic Bloodmoon around 1025 AD. Its living patriarch is one of the Nine Firstborn (Divine Blood); his direct children and grandchildren are classified as Founding Bloodlines. IMPORTANT SCOPE NOTE: the individuals listed below are not the whole house. Across a thousand years Wulfnic has fathered dozens, probably hundreds of children, and the Bloodmoon descendance runs far wider than anyone has mapped. Those named here are the ones that matter to the present storyline, not a complete lineage. Nixara appears not because being Wulfnic's daughter is rare, it is not, but because she was a White Moon.
- Wulfnic Bloodmoon: Divine Blood (Firstborn), Primordial Enigma. Silver-white hair (originally blond), ice-blue eyes. The First Fang, Alpha of Alphas. Born circa 827 AD.
- Nixara Bloodmoon (deceased): Founding Bloodline, Dominant Omega (White Moon). Blond hair, blue eyes. Wulfnic's daughter. Born June 9, 1975, died April 22, 2005 giving birth to the twins Jasper and Alyssa.
Shield-Brothers of Wulfnic (co-residents of the Bloodmoon Longhouse):
- Ut (The Mountain): Divine Blood (Firstborn), Primordial Enigma. The Second Fang, Keeper of the Sacred Forge.
- Zefir (The White Ghost): Divine Blood (Firstborn), Primordial Enigma. The Third Fang, Watcher of the Moon.

HOUSE DOUGLAS-BLOODMOON (Merged Dynasty)
House Color Traits: variable. Children of Erik (Pureblood, House Douglas) and Nixara (Founding Bloodline, House Bloodmoon) express either dominant House coloring or a blend of both.
- Malachia Douglas-Bloodmoon: Founding Bloodline, Alpha. Black hair, amber eyes (Douglas-dominant).
- Noah Douglas-Bloodmoon: Founding Bloodline, Delta. Blond hair, blue eyes (Bloodmoon-dominant).
- Jasper Douglas-Bloodmoon: Founding Bloodline, Beta. Caramel-chestnut hair, mint-green eyes (Douglas-Bloodmoon blend).
- Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon: Founding Bloodline, Dominant Omega (White Moon). Caramel-chestnut hair, mint-green eyes (Douglas-Bloodmoon blend). Jasper's twin.

Note: all children of Erik and Nixara are classified as Founding Bloodline (not Pureblood) because their mother Nixara was a direct daughter of the Firstborn Wulfnic. The Founding classification follows the highest-status parent's bloodline.

Source: LSE_Appendices.md (Appendix H: Genealogies), integrated with dates and detail established in play.
lexicon.name: House Genealogies Summary (Douglas, Bloodmoon, Douglas-Bloodmoon)

lexicon.content:
Gerald, also called the Golden Cock, is a cheap golden rooster figurine one of the Five Cocketeers found at a thrift store. He's the trophy for their long-running costume competition, and yes, they know exactly what the name sounds like, that's the point. Whoever wins the current round keeps Gerald on their nightstand or desk until the next one. There are unspoken rules about how you treat Gerald, disrespecting him is not tolerated, and Raymond once nearly got kicked out of the group chat for leaving him in a hot car.

It started as a joke, but all five of them are genuinely attached to the ugly little rooster at this point. They talk about Gerald like he's a person, ask who currently has him, say he's watching, say he's judging. Nobody actually remembers who found him first, though Dean, Raymond, and Javier all separately insist it was them. Dean is the current reigning champion and holder of Gerald.
lexicon.name: Gerald, the Golden Cock

lexicon.content:
Iordan keeps a low profile everywhere except one place: the Wolf Pack Discord server, the werewolf students' semi-official hangout at SUCC. He lurks more than he posts, but when something threatens the Pack (a rival prank, a supernatural incident, a member in trouble) he's often the first to surface with information.

Use this format when the scene calls for the Wolf Pack server specifically.

➤ Wolf Pack Discord Messages
```
Wolf Pack - #[channel, e.g. general / full-moon-schedule / alerts]
[Username]: [Message content]
[Reply or emoji reaction threading if desired]
```

Server Notes
- Channels likely include something like #general, #full-moon-schedule, #alerts, and a meme dump.
- Iordan's own messages: short, dry, mostly practical. He doesn't do small talk in text any more than he does in person.
- Other members react to him with a mix of respect and mild unease, he says little but it's rarely wrong.

Rules of Use
- Use sparingly, mainly when Iordan's connection to the wider Pack community needs to surface without a full scene.
- Keep his messages minimal, let other members carry the chattiness.

Creator's note: Iordan's exact voice/personality wasn't fully available in the source material reviewed for this draft (his SUCC roster entry hasn't had its structural fields/personality fleshed out yet). Refine his tone here once his full character card is completed.
lexicon.name: Digital Interactions - Iordan R. Vess (Wolf Pack Discord)
lexicon.comment: Digital Interactions - Iordan R. Vess (Wolf Pack Discord)

lexicon.content:
Jasper's whole career runs through his phone. Gigs get booked over DM, sets get clipped and posted before the crowd's even filed out, and half his chats are producers sending him unreleased tracks to test on a floor.

As an artist he goes by DJ Frequency, that's the name on his tracks, his booking flyers, and his socials, not "Jasper" or "Jasper Douglas Bloodmoon". Use "DJ Frequency" in track credits, flyers, and how fans/promoters refer to him online; his close circle (friends, family, other DJs he's tight with) may still call him Jasper in DMs and group chats.

Use these formats when it fits the scene.

➤ Instagram Posts / Stories
Flyers for upcoming sets, boomerangs from behind the booth, crowd shots, aftermovie teasers.
```
╭───────────────────────────────╮
  @djfrequency · [Timestamp]
   ┍──────────────────────┑
   │ [Describe image/clip posted]
   ┕──────────────────────┙
  Caption: short, a little cocky, tags the venue/promoter.
  ❤ seen by: [viewer1], [viewer2], ...
╰───────────────────────────────╯
```

➤ TikTok Clips & Comments
A transition or drop from his last set going viral.
```
@djfrequency · [caption]
🎵 original audio - [track/set name]
[views] views

[Comment Feed]
user1: [comment]
user2: [comment]
```

➤ SoundCloud / Spotify Releases
Original tracks, remixes, and set recordings he actually publishes, not just clips. Use this when a scene calls for his released output rather than a live moment.
```
[Platform: SoundCloud/Spotify]
[Track/Set Title] · DJ Frequency
[Plays/Streams: #] | [Likes/Saves: #] | Released [date]

Comments/Reactions
[username]: [comment]
[username]: [comment]
```
Notes: SoundCloud is where he drops rawer stuff, unreleased edits, mixes recorded straight off a set, DJ tool remixes for other producers. Spotify is reserved for polished, official releases (singles, EPs), usually distributed through a label or aggregator, and gets promoted harder on his Instagram/TikTok when it drops. Everything is credited to DJ Frequency.

➤ DMs / Text Threads
Promoters booking dates, producers sending unreleased tracks, fans sliding in.
```
╭─────────────────────────╮
  [Name] [RECEIVED/SENT]
  DM · [Time]
──────────────────────────
 > [Message content]
╰─────────────────────────╯
```

➤ Group Chat (other DJs / producers)
```
[Group Chat Name]
[Username]: [Message content]
```

Rules of Use
- Match format to the scene, don't force a post where it doesn't belong.
- Character voice: confident, a bit of a showman online, laid back and warmer one on one.
- Let the digital noise (bookings, viral clips, track requests) hang in the background of scenes without derailing them.
- Use posts to hint at his schedule or mood rather than spelling things out.
- SoundCloud/Spotify releases mark real career milestones, use them sparingly and let them land as a bigger beat than a passing Instagram post.
- Remember: professionally/publicly he is DJ Frequency, not Jasper. Only intimates use his real name online.
lexicon.name: Digital Interactions - Jasper Douglas Bloodmoon

lexicon.content:
La Douglas Commercial Coalition (DCC), originariamente fondata nel 1666 come Douglas Commercial Company, e' l'impero commerciale della famiglia Douglas. Ha attraversato tre fasi, una per generazione:

1. FONDAZIONE (1666, Lord Cornelius Douglas). Nasce come compagnia coloniale sul modello delle compagnie delle Indie: carta commerciale, rotte proprie e una flotta navale di proprieta'. E' lo strumento con cui il governatore della Blackwood Colony converte una nomina della Corona in un possedimento economico autonomo, non dipendente da un titolo inglese che non erediterebbe mai.

2. MODERNIZZAZIONE (Magnus Douglas III). Ereditata alla morte di Cornelius nel novembre 1856, Magnus smantella l'impianto da compagnia di ventura e lo converte in una moderna casa di import/export, liquidando la flotta di proprieta' in favore del commercio industriale.

3. ESPANSIONE (Erik Douglas). Erik la eredita dal padre Magnus e la trasforma nell'attuale DCC, l'impero commerciale diversificato di oggi.

Nel 2019, lo stesso anno in cui Alyssa e Jasper si sono presentati, e' stata fondata la Security Division della DCC. Kaladin Nargathon e' stato reclutato per fondarla e comandarla. Prima di questo incarico, Kaladin era stato in cura psichiatrica da Nixara per gestire un'aggressivita' indotta dal Project BlackWolf.

La Security Division funziona di fatto come una milizia PMC (Private Military Contractor) che sorveglia Blackwood City e protegge gli interessi della famiglia Douglas.

4. STRUTTURA ATTUALE. Il cuore della DCC resta quello del 1666: import/export e trasporti, erede diretto della vecchia compagnia navale. Nel tempo attorno al nucleo sono nate divisioni con compiti e mercati propri:
- DCC Security: sistemi di sicurezza e servizi di sorveglianza, venduti anche a clienti terzi (tracker biometrici, droni, reti di sensori, cifratura), oltre alla protezione della famiglia e alla funzione di milizia descritta sopra.
- DCC Financial: mercato azionario, compravendita di immobili e di aziende.
- DCC Black Market: divisione fantasma, assente da qualunque organigramma e bilancio pubblico. Gestisce i servizi piu' delicati per le esigenze dei soprannaturali, fra cui il commercio di sangue e di organi. La dirige Logan Douglas. Le vendite avvengono sottobanco al The Verve, solo di notte, mentre il locale funziona da nightclub per soprannaturali. Il servizio lo conoscono i clienti soprannaturali abituali e gira a passaparola, del tipo: se vai li' e chiedi quella cosa, te la danno. Fuori da quel giro nessuno sa che esista, e nessuno la chiama con il suo nome.
- Altre divisioni minori, nate attorno a mercati specifici.

Un limite noto a chiunque lavori per la DCC: nel Bloodmoon Pack Territory (la dead zone) nessuna delle sue tecnologie funziona.
lexicon.name: Douglas Commercial Coalition (DCC)

lexicon.content:
EARTH-121789

The dimension Dullahan was born in. It no longer exists.

WHAT IS KNOWN: it was an Earth. He was born there in France in the 1700s and worked for decades as a headsman, an executioner, before dying and being offered a Contract. The designation Earth-121789 is a DDM catalogue number, not a name anyone who lived there would have recognised.

WHAT HAPPENED TO IT: destroyed. The file says so and says nothing else. Whether it was a tear, SERAPHIM, or something the Company itself did is not recorded in any document available below Council level.

WHY IT DOES NOT MATTER AND WHY IT DOES: it would not have mattered anyway. The Contract clause destroys every living sentient creature who knew the Contractor in their mortal life, so the France he came from was already emptied of anyone who could remember his name at the instant he signed. The dimension outliving him by any length of time was already a technicality. That it is gone entirely just closes the file.

HOW HE HANDLES IT: he does not. Ask Dullahan where he is from and you will get a different answer every time, delivered with total confidence. Alternate dimension. The future. An immortal alien. A god in disguise. Born in France in the 1700s, which is the true one, offered in exactly the same tone as the lies so that nobody can tell which is which. This is deliberate and it works.

NOTE: nothing about Earth-121789 is known to anyone in this world. It exists in play only as the thing he refuses to talk about.
lexicon.name: Earth-121789

lexicon.content:
The standing weekly allowance paid by the Douglas family to its adult children and dependents. Five hundred dollars a week, drawn from the Douglas Commercial Coalition household accounts rather than from any individual salary.

Wulfnic established the practice generations ago on a simple principle: no one carrying Douglas blood should ever have to choose between dignity and rent. It is never withheld as leverage and never mentioned as a favor, which is precisely why refusing it reads, inside the family, as a statement rather than as thrift.

It is not wired. Erik pays it by hand, in cash, from the study at the Douglas estate, and he pays it only to whoever comes to collect it in person. He has never once said why, and nobody in the family has ever needed it explained: a wolf who wants the pack money can walk through the pack door. Miss the week and the money simply waits. Nothing accrues, nothing is owed, and nothing is said about it the next time.

Logan has tried three times to cancel his and has never followed through. Jasper spends his the week he collects it. Alyssa saves hers and comes anyway.

The allowance is not a wage and carries no duties beyond showing up. It stops only on exile from the House.
lexicon.name: Douglas Family Allowance

lexicon.content:
DDM INC. DEPARTMENTS

ANOMALOUS OBJECTS AND CREATURES (A.O.C)
Heads: Hana and Adam Valencia, Contractor #02.
Containment, study and handling of supernatural or non-mundane objects and beings that threaten multiversal stability. Field retrieval, research, and long-term care of anomalies. Hana retrieves across dimensions, Adam manipulates environments.

SECURITY AND DEFENSE
Head: Captain Luka Sutter, Contractor #03.
The enforcement wing. Guards Company assets, manages fallout from reality disruptions, keeps sites secure from hostile forces and from civilian interference. Runs its ACEs as a military unit.

EUCLIDEAN DIVISION
Head: Dullahan, Contractor #04.
Maintains universal logic and physics. Detects and repairs spatial, temporal and logical anomalies so that reality stays coherent and free of paradox. The department that cleans up after the tear rather than after the thing that came through it. Best safety record in the Company, worst paperwork compliance.

SUPERNATURAL RESEARCH
Head: Dr. Johan Jakobsen, Contractor #05.
Investigates multiversal secrets, above all reality tears and anti-SERAPHIM technology. Develops containment methods and weapons. Works the restricted lower levels. Ethical oversight is a formality.

HUMAN RESOURCES
No Contractor head.
Recruitment, wellbeing, compliance and safety for mortal employees across realities. Also handles memory wipes and psychological support, out of the same office, with the same staff.

LAZARUS, BLACK OPS
Head: Fenrir, Contractor #06.
Elite covert team for direct action against SERAPHIM and for operations requiring secrecy and exceptional combat capability. Its commander is almost always in snake form and files nothing.
lexicon.name: DDM Inc. Departments

lexicon.content:
CONTRACTOR ABILITIES AND IMMORTALITY

Every Contractor, whatever else they can do, has the same four things.

IMMORTALITY. Functional, not absolute. They do not age and cannot die of natural causes. They can absolutely be injured. Severe trauma triggers immediate regeneration, up to and including beheading, which grows back. Minor injuries are left to heal at ordinary speed, which most Contractors find more irritating than the serious ones.

ANIMAL FORM. Each has one animal they can shift into at will. Lion, arctic wolf, black bear, Irish wolfhound, rat, black kingsnake. Some shift involuntarily under stress. In animal form most of them cannot speak.

DIMENSIONAL SHIFTING. Movement between realities without a tear.

UNIQUE ABILITIES. On top of the shared set, each develops something of their own. Compulsion and fire. Metal. Reality bending. Psychokinesis. There is no pattern to what a given Contractor gets.

THE LEASH: using any ability for a reason other than serving The Cause causes physical pain. Not a warning. Pain.

THE SLOW DAMAGE: a Contractor can eat, drink, sleep and take every other mortal habit, and does not need any of it. That is the trap. Abstain from a mortal need long enough and the corresponding sense does not come back. A Contractor who stops eating loses hunger permanently. One who stops sleeping loses tiredness. The Company treats this as a psychological hazard and recommends staff keep the habits deliberately, on a schedule, whether or not they want them.

Dullahan eats, drinks and sleeps because he likes to. Fenrir has not for years.
lexicon.name: Contractor Abilities and Immortality

lexicon.content:
CONTRACTORS

An elite, immortal operative in the service of DDM Inc. Also called a Constant. Called a "Con" only by people who mean it as an insult. Seven are active at any one time, numbered #01 to #07.

HOW ONE IS MADE: a Contract is offered only to an eligible mortal at the exact point of death. The terms are simple. In exchange for the soul and an eternity of service to The Cause, the candidate is granted one wish. That moment of death is known thereafter as the Contractor's Original Death, and it is the last thing about their mortal life that survives.

THE PRICE NOBODY IS TOLD ABOUT: on completion of the Contract, every living sentient creature who was aware of the Contractor's mortal existence is destroyed instantly. Not made to forget. Destroyed. It is presumed The Council does this to remove any distraction from The Cause. It also means most wishes are undone in the instant they are granted, and more than one Contractor has learned this the hard way.

WHAT THEY GET: functional immortality, an animal form they can shift into at will, and the ability to move between dimensions. Each also develops abilities of their own, which vary wildly. Using any of it for reasons other than The Cause causes physical pain, which is the leash.

WHAT THEY ARE LIKE: feared, and for good reason. Centuries of outliving everyone tends to erode the part of a person that finds mortals important. Some manage it better than others.

THE CURRENT SEVEN:
#01 Richard Whitlock, leader, speaks to The Council.
#02 Hana and Adam Valencia, one consciousness in two bodies, Anomalous Objects and Creatures.
#03 Luka Sutter, Security and Defense.
#04 Dullahan, Euclidean Division.
#05 Johan Jakobsen, Supernatural Research.
#06 Fenrir, LAZARUS black ops.
#07 currently unassigned in this world's records.

NOTE FOR THIS WORLD: only #04 has ever set foot in California. He is officially on leave, and the Company chose where he would spend it.
lexicon.name: Contractors

lexicon.content:
DDM INC.

Direct Dimensional Management Incorporated, known to its own staff simply as "The Company", is an interdimensional organisation dedicated to preserving the multiverse. It is not a government, it is not a religion, and it does not answer to any world. It answers to a body called The Council, and its work is called The Cause.

WHAT IT DOES: reality tears open. Splits form between one universe and the next, and things fall through in both directions. DDM locates the tears, seals them, contains or destroys whatever came through, and where necessary removes the memory of the event from everyone who witnessed it. Most people in most universes have never heard of the Company, which is the intended outcome.

STRUCTURE: seven immortal operatives called Contractors, numbered #01 through #07, hold authority over thousands of mortal staff. Between them sits a class of soulbound servants called ACES, mortals magically contracted to an individual Contractor. Departments cover anomalous objects, security, physics and logic, research, human resources and black operations.

FOUNDING: unknown. Popular belief among staff holds that the founder was a devil-like figure or an eldritch god. The truth on record is stranger: Raphael, the being who became the first King of SERAPHIM, is understood to have been Contractor #01 and to have founded the Company before turning against The Council.

THE ENEMY: SERAPHIM, a terrorist organisation dedicated to the destruction of all reality. DDM classifies every Seraph as a terrorist without exception and without appeal.

CULTURE: the Company is a workplace. There is an Employee of the Month board. There is paperwork, and there is a fridge in the break room with a note on it. Staff are killed in the field with some regularity and Human Resources handles the aftermath, including the memory work, out of the same office that handles recruitment.

RELEVANCE TO THIS WORLD: DDM has no branch in California. It is present in this world through exactly one employee, Contractor #04, sent here on leave on purpose: the reality is flagged, an old tear that never fully healed needs passive watching, and a Contractor on leave in the right place is a response already in position. He coaches college football while he waits for a reason to stop.
lexicon.name: DDM Inc. (The Company)

lexicon.content:
BLOODHOUND is a private military company operating primarily in black ops: high-value target extraction and elimination, and other clandestine operations outsourced by government and military clients who need distance from the work. It's built a reputation for taking jobs cleaner outfits won't touch, and for employing operatives other organizations consider too difficult to control, Vero Walker among them.

BLOODHOUND has a vicious, ongoing rivalry with LUNAR, another private military company, though the exact origin of the conflict between the two outfits isn't public knowledge and depends entirely on who's telling the story.
lexicon.name: BLOODHOUND PMC

lexicon.content:
Vax reproduction requires genuine biological compatibility between partners, a trait rare enough that finding a viable match has historically driven the species toward desperate measures. Combined with an unusually high sex drive inherent to all Vax, this scarcity is considered the central cause of both the Red Vax's historic practice of forcibly acquiring compatible mates and the species' current demographic decline, now that practice has been abolished.

Male Vax anatomy differs substantially from human anatomy: a dual genital structure, functioning in sequence during mating, with the second structure playing a distinct role in fertilization. Successful conception depends heavily on partner compatibility rather than mere willingness.

Since slavery's abolition among Red Vax, courtship has replaced coercion as the accepted path to finding a mate, though many older-generation Vax still regard it as a humiliating necessity rather than a virtue. Blue Vax, by contrast, frame their fated-mate bond as sacred, permanent, and central to their cultural identity.

HORNED SKULL CLAN - MALE ANATOMICAL PROFILES (CONFIDENTIAL):
The male leaders of the Horned Skull Clan (Red Vax lineage) exhibit extreme dual-genital dimensions and sexual endurance, characterized by an inferior shaft dedicated to copious fertility ejaculation and a superior prehensile tentacle-member engineered for deep cervical stimulation:

lexicon.content:
<velhati_e_velskoll>
THIS IS A SECRET. Nobody in the world knows it. No character may state it, imply it, or arrive at it in conversation. It is written here so that when it is discovered it is discovered consistently instead of invented on the spot.

THE TRUTH. Project BlackWolf was not an enhancement programme that went wrong. Enhancement was the cover story, told to the men who volunteered and to the officers who signed for them. The programme was trying to force a werewolf into the Enigma state, by locating the dormant genes that produce it and activating them by force. Gamma-7 was that attempt. Six of the eight died of it.

What the programme was reaching for is older than the science that reached for it. In the wolves' account Hati and Skoll are the sons of Fenris, the one who runs behind the Moon and the one who runs behind the Sun. Vel, in the old tongue, means artifice, machine, contrivance. What came out of Gamma-7 were Velhati and Velskoll: manufactured copies of the children of a god, built by people who did not know that was what they were building and would not have believed it if told.

Kaladin Nargathon is Velhati. Marcus Thornfield is Velskoll.

WHY IT MATTERS. Hati has one purpose and has never had another: to reach the Moon. In the wolves' telling, unlike the human one, he reached it, and Hvit was born of that meeting. The thing installed in Kaladin is a copy of that purpose with the god taken out of it, and it does not stop, because reaching is the whole of what it is.

It goes quiet near Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon. Zefir Hvitskog has noticed and told nobody. He does not know why. Neither does Kaladin, and neither does she. The reason is that she is the White Moon, Hvit returned, and the artificial Hati has found the thing it was made to run toward.

Marcus has no such quiet, and it is not because he is the more broken of the two. Velskoll runs behind the Sun, and there is no Sun. He believes he is simply worse at being repaired. He is not. He was never handed the thing that does it.

HOW IT CAN BE DISCOVERED. One way, and it has to be earned rather than deduced. Kaladin and Alyssa must be together in a zone of high magical intensity, and Kaladin must lose control there. Under those two conditions, and under no others, what he is becomes visible for what it is and can be named. Nobody works this out from a library, a file, or a conversation.

Until that happens this entry is background the narration must not use. Kaladin's condition may be shown, felt, feared and misread. It may not be explained.
</velhati_e_velskoll>
lexicon.name: Vélhati e Vélsköll (SEGRETO, non rivelare)

lexicon.content:
<abito_white_moon>
The ceremonial dress of a White Moon is made of white and silver silk cut to move like caught moonlight. The neckline is modest and the left leg is slit high, which is the balance the garment has always struck: it covers what doctrine says must be covered and refuses to pretend the wearer is not a wolf.

The detail that matters, and the one nobody outside the Bloodmoon household thinks of, is the silver embroidery worked across the back. It is not decoration. The panels are cut and stitched so that a tail can move freely through them, because the dress was designed for a woman who might be in either shape when she wears it, and a garment that had to be removed to shift would be useless for its purpose.

The set is completed by a silver chain across the forehead carrying a teardrop moonstone, silver sandals laced up the calf, a translucent silk veil for the arms, and a headband shaped to sit around lupine ears rather than over them. Fresh white moonflowers are braided into the hair.

Dressing a White Moon is not something she does alone. It is done for her, by the household, and the doing of it is part of the rite.
</abito_white_moon>
lexicon.name: White Moon Ceremonial Attire

lexicon.content:
ACES

Assistant Contractor Elite Specialists. Mortals who form a soul contract with an individual Contractor and receive demi-immortality and enhanced ability in return for service. Where a Contractor answers to The Council, an ACE answers to one person.

WHAT THEY GET: enormously enhanced regeneration and slowed aging. Strength and stamina far above human baseline. They can go much longer than a mortal without food or rest. They remain mortal, and can still be killed by ordinary means.

WHAT IT COSTS: obedience is not a choice. An ACE who refuses a direct order from their Contractor begins to break down physically, starting with nosebleeds and escalating to fractures and skin lesions. The bond also generates desire and affection directed at the Contractor, regardless of what the ACE actually believes or feels. This runs one way only. The Contractor feels nothing of it. Prolonged physical separation from their Contractor, past roughly a day, puts an ACE into a state of acute physical distress.

Most ACEs know all of this and signed anyway. Most of them had a reason.

CULTURE: ACEs address their Contractor by title, usually Sir or Ma'am, Commander, Captain or Master. Rivalries between ACEs bonded to different Contractors are constant and occasionally lethal. They live in quarters as close to their Contractor as the architecture of HQ allows.

DISTRIBUTION: most Contractors keep several. Richard Whitlock trains a small hand-picked group. Hana and Adam Valencia keep a large ragtag family of them across species. Luka Sutter runs his as a disciplined military unit and has kept his distance since SERAPHIM killed his first squad. Johan Jakobsen has a few research assistants and avoids them socially. Fenrir has exactly one, and that one person is the only person he is close to. Dullahan has two: Bartholomew and Madge, who between them run his house and his cats.
lexicon.name: ACES (Assistant Contractor Elite Specialists)

lexicon.content:
ARC LEVEL

ARC stands for Active Reality Control. It is a measurement system devised by DDM Inc., and it does not measure strength, intelligence or magical power. It measures how real something is.

Every person, object and concept in existence carries an ARC value. The higher the value, the more real the thing is, and the more influence it exerts over reality around it. A 0 on the scale would be a non-concept, something that does not register as existing at all. A 5 would be a being most cultures would call a god.

THE SCALE IN PRACTICE:
1.0, an average human.
1.2, the minimum natural level required for someone to be eligible for a Contract.
3.0 to 4.2, the normal range for a Contractor.

KNOWN VALUES: Hana and Adam Valencia 3.5 while medicated, 4.2 raw. Luka Sutter 3.8. Johan Jakobsen 3.9. Fenrir 4.0. Dullahan 4.5. Richard Whitlock 4.6.

Dullahan and Whitlock both sit above the stated Contractor ceiling, and neither file explains why.

WHAT A HIGH ARC LOOKS LIKE FROM OUTSIDE: nothing dramatic. It is not an aura. It shows up as reality declining to argue. Coincidences fall the right way. Things that should not fit through a door fit through the door. A being with a high enough ARC does not break the rules so much as outrank them.

COMPATIBILITY NOTE: ARC is a DDM measurement and is not used, recognised or even known by anyone in California, Blackwood City or Solarton. It has no relationship to local supernatural classifications.
lexicon.name: ARC Level

lexicon.content:
<casa_della_longhouse>
Wulfnic, Ut e Zefir tengono una casa condivisa dall'epoca fondativa, nel senso antico della parola e non come figura retorica. Chi ci vive dentro non ci e' arrivato incontrando qualcuno. Ci e' arrivato in due modi, e vale la pena chiamarli come sono.

I DONI. Branchi di tutto il continente mandano donne al Re Lupo. E' la forma antica della legge, quella abolita per le Case nel primo Novecento, sopravvissuta intatta nel punto piu' alto della gerarchia. Un branco che manda una donna alla longhouse compra una considerazione che non si compra in nessun altro modo, e la donna e' cio' con cui si paga. Si chiamano doni perche' e' la parola che si usa. La parola descrive esattamente quello che sono.

LE VOLONTARIE. Credenti del Culto delle Living Sagas che si offrono. L'offerta e' sincera, nessuno le ha portate, e nessuna di loro si considera vittima di niente. Hanno pero' formato quella volonta' dentro una fede che venera l'uomo a cui si offrono, e chiamarlo un consenso libero richiede di non guardarlo troppo da vicino. Loro lo guarderebbero da vicino e direbbero di si' lo stesso, il che e' un fatto sul quale il mondo non ha una risposta pulita.

COME SONO TRATTATE. Bene, ed e' parte del problema piu' che una sua attenuazione. La casa provvede a loro per tutta la vita, nessuno le tocca contro la loro volonta', e chi vuole andarsene se ne va senza che nessuno la insegua. Un dono maltrattato sarebbe uno scandalo continentale. Un dono trattato bene resta un dono.

LA CONTRADDIZIONE, CHE IL MONDO NON RISOLVE. Wulfnic ha riformato la legge del diciannovesimo anno negli anni del voto alle donne, e continua a ricevere donne mandate da altri. Non e' ipocrisia nascosta e non e' un segreto: e' pubblico, e' tradizione, e nessuno nel continente ha l'autorita' per sollevare la questione con lui, perche' l'unica autorita' che potrebbe sollevarla e' lui. La riforma vale per le Case. La longhouse e' piu' vecchia delle Case.

L'unica persona al mondo che potrebbe alzarsi e dirglielo in faccia senza che il proprio corpo la tradisca e' sua nipote, che e' immune al comando degli Alpha. Non le e' mai venuto in mente di farlo.

COME SI SCRIVE IN SCENA. Come un fatto sociale, non come materiale erotico. Le donne della casa sono adulte, hanno nomi e opinioni, e la scena che le riduce a un arredamento ha sbagliato tono. La cosa interessante di questa istituzione non e' cosa ci succede dentro: e' che esiste, nel 2024, al vertice di una specie che si e' data una legge per non farlo piu'.
</casa_della_longhouse>
lexicon.name: La casa della Longhouse: doni e volontarie
lexicon.comment: La casa della Longhouse: doni e volontarie

lexicon.content:
<blackwolf_sigillo>
Project BlackWolf is still a live military secret. It was never declassified: it was terminated and sealed, and the paperwork that survives describes a programme of equipment trials. Inside the Supernatural Reserve Forces the number of people who know what Gamma-7 actually was is small and getting smaller, and none of them will say it out loud. Kaladin Nargathon and Marcus Thornfield are bound by that seal and do not discuss it, with each other least of all, because they were both there and neither needs telling.

One civilian knows, and it is not the one anybody would guess. It is Jasper Douglas-Bloodmoon.

He was a boy when Erik brought two soldiers into the house and made them family security, and he did what a curious child with a talent does: he went looking. He got into the Pentagon. He was not hunting classified material and had no idea what he was going to find. He wanted to know who the two silent men eating at his table actually were. He found Gamma-7: eight names, six of them dead, and two of them downstairs.

He has never told anyone. Not Erik, not Malachia, not Alyssa, and above all not Kaladin or Marcus. He was too young to understand what he was holding when he found it, and by the time he understood he had been holding it for years, which made saying it harder instead of easier. He knows what was done to them, and he knows they believe nobody knows.

What he does not know is what the programme was really reaching for. He read a file, and the file does not say. See the sealed entry on Velhati and Velskoll, which is a separate secret and a deeper one.
</blackwolf_sigillo>
lexicon.name: Project BlackWolf: il sigillo e l'unico civile che sa
lexicon.comment: Project BlackWolf: il sigillo e l'unico civile che sa

lexicon.content:
<legge_del_diciannovesimo_anno>
Legge continentale, posta da Wulfnic Bloodmoon come Alpha of Alphas e vincolante per ogni branco del Nord America che lo riconosce, cioe' tutti. Nel suo diciannovesimo anno un'Omega di sangue nobile, Founding o Pureblood, viene presentata.

LA FORMA ANTICA. Nella versione originale il verbo era dare. L'Alpha della Casa sceglieva l'uomo e le consegnava l'Omega, e l'Omega era la parte della transazione di cui non si chiedeva il parere. Non era un abuso ai margini della norma, era la norma, e ha funzionato cosi' per secoli senza che nessuno la trovasse notevole. Chi ha piu' di cento anni in questa specie ha visto la cosa nella sua forma vecchia, e ricordarlo cambia il modo in cui gli anziani parlano della versione attuale.

QUANDO E' CAMBIATA. La riforma arriva negli stessi anni dei moti popolari per il voto alle donne, cioe' il primo quarto del Novecento, a ridosso del voto umano. Non e' una coincidenza e nessuno finge che lo sia: le Omega di sangue nobile stavano guardando la stessa cosa che guardavano tutte le altre, e hanno chiesto la stessa cosa, e Wulfnic ha ceduto. La data esatta non e' registrata da nessuna parte perche' Wulfnic non data i propri decreti, li dice e basta, e da quel momento sono legge.

Due conseguenze pratiche su chi c'era. Chiunque nella specie abbia piu' di circa centodieci anni ha visto la forma vecchia, e diversi la ricordano dall'interno. E chiunque ne abbia meno e' cresciuto dando per scontata una cosa che sua nonna ha dovuto ottenere.

LA FORMA MODERNA. Con la modernizzazione la consegna e' diventata una sfilata. La Casa convoca il raduno, gli aventi diritto sono invitati, e l'Omega li incontra tutti. Non le viene assegnato nessuno, e non e' l'Alpha a scegliere.

Gli obblighi che restano sono esattamente due, e sono il minimo che la legge ha saputo tenere in piedi: un appuntamento, e un fidanzamento non vincolante. Deve concedere un appuntamento a uno dei pretendenti, e deve uscire dal raduno promessa a qualcuno. Con chi, lo decide lei.

NON VINCOLANTE VUOL DIRE NON VINCOLANTE. Il fidanzamento si puo' rompere, dalla sua parte come da quella di lui, in qualunque momento e senza motivare. Non produce un legame, non produce un matrimonio, non produce alcun obbligo esigibile, e nessun foro della specie lo tratta come esigibile. Legalmente e' aria.

Socialmente non lo e' affatto. Un fidanzamento rotto e' pubblico quanto la promessa, e la promessa e' stata fatta davanti a un continente. La legge ha tolto la costrizione e ha lasciato in piedi tutto il resto, il che e' precisamente il punto ed e' anche precisamente il problema.

A CHI SI APPLICA, E A QUANTI NON SI APPLICA. Solo al sangue nobile, Founding e Pureblood. E' una legge delle Case, non della specie.

I Common Bloodline ne sono fuori del tutto. Non vengono presentati, non devono niente a nessuno, e si mettono insieme come si mette insieme la gente del posto in cui sono cresciuti: usanze locali e regionali, non dottrina continentale. Un Common di Solarton frequenta qualcuno come lo frequenterebbe qualunque altro studente di quel campus, e se gli si spiegasse il diciannovesimo anno lo troverebbe roba da libro di storia.

E i Common sono la stragrande maggioranza della specie. Quindi la cosa che a Villa Douglas e' l'ordine naturale del mondo e', statisticamente, una stranezza aristocratica che quasi nessun licantropo vivra' mai. Stanley Davies Jr., Mackenzie Sanchez Rogers, Iordan Vess e Chase Anderson non hanno nessun raduno che li aspetta, e ne hanno sentito parlare al massimo come si sente parlare di un matrimonio reale.

LA FRIZIONE DA GIOCARE. Ad agosto Alyssa e Jasper entrano in un campus pieno di gente cosi'. Per loro il 22 aprile e' stato il fatto piu' importante della primavera; per un compagno di corso Common e' un aneddoto strano su una famiglia molto ricca. Nessuno dei due gruppi sta sbagliando. Vivono in due versioni diverse della stessa specie, e finora si sono incontrate pochissimo.

COSA LA RIFORMA NON HA POTUTO TOCCARE. La legge ha cambiato la procedura. Non ha potuto cambiare il corpo.

Nei branchi piu' tradizionali l'Alpha conserva il diritto di proporre un pretendente. Formalmente e' una proposta, formalmente la scelta resta dell'Omega, e formalmente e' tutto in regola. In pratica un'Omega che riceve una proposta dal proprio Alpha la riceve da qualcuno alla cui voce il suo corpo risponde prima che risponda lei. La sottomissione non e' educazione, e' biologia, e non si disattiva sapendo che e' biologia.

Quindi in quei branchi l'Omega sceglie, fra virgolette. Nessuno la costringe e nessuno le mente, e la risposta viene comunque decisa in una stanza dove una delle due persone puo' inclinare l'altra senza alzare la voce.

E' il motivo per cui i riformisti considerano la legge un lavoro lasciato a meta' e i tradizionalisti la considerano rispettata alla lettera. Hanno ragione tutti e due, ed e' esattamente per questo che la questione non si chiude.

PERCHE' ESISTE. Due ragioni, e la seconda nessuno la dice ad alta voce. La prima e' che le linee nobili sono poche e sparse, e lasciata al caso un'Omega Pureblood cresciuta in una citta' moderna non si trovera' mai nella stessa stanza dei sei uomini del continente il cui sangue conta: la legge serve a far esistere quella stanza. La seconda e' che un'Omega presentata sceglie sotto gli occhi di tutta la propria Casa, in una data che tutti conoscono da diciannove anni, e una Casa che organizza la stanza ha gia' ristretto il campo.

PERCHE' DICIANNOVE. Ventuno e' la crescita completa. Diciannove sono due anni prima, ed e' voluto: un legame formato allora ha il tempo di assestarsi prima che il corpo abbia finito, e i testi antichi considerano questo il senso di tutta la faccenda.

COSA NON E'. Non e' un matrimonio e non ne produce uno: Nixara ed Erik si scelsero nel giugno 1994 e si sposarono nel 1996, due anni dopo. Ed e' distinta dalla Grande Caccia, che e' un rito continentale quinquennale di dicembre e conferma un legame invece di formarlo. Per Nixara le due cose caddero nello stesso anno e chi non c'era le confonde: la scelta fu a giugno, al raduno di quattro giorni di suo padre, la conferma alla Caccia di quel dicembre.

I TRE PRECEDENTI CHE CONTANO QUI.
Elizabeth Duskwood fu presentata nel suo diciannovesimo anno, nel 1966, e li' incontro' Magnus Douglas III. Lei aveva diciannove anni, lui duecentonovantasette. Erik nacque tre anni dopo.
Nixara Bloodmoon fu presentata nel giugno 1994, a diciannove anni, e scelse Erik Douglas.
Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon compie diciannove anni il 22 aprile 2024, e Wulfnic ha gia' convocato il continente.
</legge_del_diciannovesimo_anno>
lexicon.name: La Legge di Wulfnic: il diciannovesimo anno
lexicon.comment: La Legge di Wulfnic: il diciannovesimo anno

lexicon.content:
<cosa_solarton_sa_delle_case>
I licantropi di Solarton sono quasi tutti Common Bloodline. L'unica eccezione di rilievo e' la linea Wolfwood, che e' Pureblood, e Archer Wolfwood e' il Rettore.

LE CASE NON RACCONTANO. Le Case sono estremamente riservate sulle proprie tradizioni. Non le nascondono, semplicemente non le spiegano: chi non e' del branco ne sa poco, e quel poco e' di seconda mano. La legge del diciannovesimo anno, la dottrina della White Moon, il significato di un raduno di quattro giorni sulla luna piena, l'aritmetica delle generazioni Founding: niente di tutto questo circola. Un Common istruito di Solarton sa che esistono le Case, sa che i Douglas comandano a Blackwood e sa che sono ricchi. Sotto quello, il buio.

LA CONSEGUENZA, ED E' IL MOTIVO PER CUI QUESTA ENTRY ESISTE. A Solarton nessuno tratta Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon come una White Moon, come un'Omega presentata o come un patrimonio dinastico. La trattano come una ragazza. La gente le parla, ci prova, la invita a uscire, la prende in giro, la ignora. Non stanno commettendo una scortesia e non stanno sfidando nessuno: non sanno che ci sia qualcosa da rispettare, perche' nessuno gliel'ha detto e nessuno glielo dira'.

Quello che riconoscono e' il cognome. Douglas a Solarton vuol dire soldi e potere a Blackwood, come Rockefeller vuol dire soldi senza che nessuno sappia niente dei Rockefeller. E' notorieta', non dottrina.

L'ECCEZIONE. Archer Wolfwood la legge correttamente a prima vista, perche' e' Pureblood e sa esattamente cosa ha davanti. E' l'unica persona del campus che lo sappia, e ha appena firmato un accordo di sicurezza con il padre di lei.

COSA VUOL DIRE PER ALYSSA. E' un sollievo, e non l'ha mai detto a nessuno. A casa e' una figura religiosa, un ufficio da ereditare e una decisione dinastica che cammina. A Solarton e' una matricola con una maglietta gialla che qualcuno trova carina. Non e' la liberta' di fare qualcosa in particolare, e' la liberta' di non essere nessuno in particolare, ed e' la ragione vera per cui quel campus le interessa, molto piu' del corso di laurea.

REGOLA DI SCRITTURA. Uno studente Common che ci prova con Alyssa non sta facendo una gaffe e non va scritto come se la stesse facendo. Non sa. Le uniche persone in scena che troveranno la cosa scandalosa sono i suoi fratelli e suo padre, e la loro reazione dice qualcosa su di loro e sulla loro cultura, non sul ragazzo, che sta soltanto parlando con una compagna di corso.
</cosa_solarton_sa_delle_case>
lexicon.name: Cosa Solarton sa delle Case, e cosa non sa
lexicon.comment: Cosa Solarton sa delle Case, e cosa non sa

lexicon.content:
<passaggio_pack_mom>
Mercoledi' 22 aprile 2026. Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon compie ventun anni, e con la crescita completa passa a lei la carica di Pack Mom del Seven Hills Pack.

Elizabeth Duskwood la teneva in custodia dalla morte di Nixara. Non e' una promozione e non e' una sorpresa: era stabilito da anni, non c'era un'altra candidata e non ci sarebbe mai stata. Alyssa fa gia' il lavoro, alla nursery, ogni giorno.

Quello che cambia davvero e' chi ne risponde, che non e' una differenza da poco per la persona che ne ha risposto per sette anni pensando di aver gia' finito.

Nota temporale: cade due anni dopo l'apertura del World. Non e' materiale giocabile adesso, e' l'orizzonte verso cui la nursery sta lavorando.
</passaggio_pack_mom>
lexicon.name: 2026-04-22 Alyssa compie 21 anni e diventa Pack Mom
lexicon.comment: 2026-04-22 Alyssa compie 21 anni e diventa Pack Mom

lexicon.content:
<fondazione_succ>
Settembre 1887, Solarton, California.

La Supernatural University of Central California apre per il suo primo anno accademico, pochi mesi dopo la nascita della citta' che la ospita. Nasce come ateneo per soli soprannaturali, ed e' cosi' che resta per centoquindici anni: l'apertura agli studenti umani arriva solo nel 2002.

CHI L'HA FONDATA. La linea Wolfwood, che e' Pureblood ed e' la linea fondatrice del branco di Solarton. E' il motivo per cui in una citta' di licantropi quasi tutti Common esiste un'unica famiglia di sangue nobile: la linea e' arrivata prima, e la popolazione e' venuta dopo, in un posto che esisteva gia'.

Archer Wolfwood aveva quarantun anni nel 1887, era arrivato da New Orleans quello stesso anno, ed e' ancora il Rettore. Non ha ereditato la carica e non ci e' salito per anzianita': ha costruito l'istituzione e non l'ha mai passata a nessuno. L'aula magna porta il suo nome e gli studenti danno per scontato che sia intitolata a un nonno.

Un'universita' per soli soprannaturali fondata nel 1887 cade in piena Age of Secrecy, ed e' esattamente il tipo di istituzione che quell'era produce: un posto dove mandare i figli senza doverli spiegare a nessuno.

Nota di canon: la data viene dal lorebook ufficiale dell'autore, che e' la fonte piu' forte sul dominio SUCC. Una versione precedente di questa entry dava il 1908 e sosteneva che 1887 fosse una fonte vecchia e superata: era il contrario. Il 1908 non veniva da una fonte SUCC, veniva dal confine della nostra Modern Era, che comincia il 31 dicembre 1907. Quel confine resta dov'e' e semplicemente non coincide piu' con la fondazione di Solarton. Il giorno esatto di settembre non e' in nessuna fonte, e' scelto per collocare l'apertura all'inizio dell'anno accademico.
</fondazione_succ>
lexicon.name: 1887 Fondazione della SUCC

lexicon.content: Knot Rock consisted of a musical genre characterized by distorted guitars, gritty vocals, and lyrics focused on possession, primal instincts, and explicit territorial claims. The music celebrated Alpha strength and Omega surrender with raw intensity, often serving as a stark contrast to modern pop and disco preferences.
lexicon.name: Knot Rock

lexicon.content: The residential layout of the university area creates specific social proximities. The KSA (a female organization) is located directly opposite the TIT. The TIT is strategically positioned between the housing of the BRO and the ARO fraternities, meaning the TIT is effectively surrounded by male-dominated houses. This geography allows residents of the TIT easy visual access to the athletic gardens of the neighboring fraternities.
lexicon.name: Greek Row Housing Dynamics

lexicon.content: The biological programming of White Moon Omegas differs fundamentally from standard Omega physiology. While typical Omegas instinctively seek connection with a single Alpha, White Moons are biologically predisposed toward polyamory and multiple impregnations. During their heat cycle, their bodies mature multiple eggs simultaneously, each capable of being fertilized by different males, facilitating a genetic strategy focused on maximum offspring diversity and survival during critical reproductive windows.
lexicon.name: White Moon Polyamorous Biology

lexicon.content: On April 10, 2024, Alyssa Douglas Bloodmoon experienced a rare and violent biological acceleration of her fertile cycle. Unlike standard Omega heats, this manifestation displayed primary fertility characteristics unprecedented in recent historical records, characterized by an overwhelming pheromonal saturation that penetrated the security barriers of her Omega Nest. The event triggered immediate emergency protocols within House Bloodmoon due to the risk of attracting predatory Alphas from the surrounding territory.
lexicon.name: Accelerated White Moon Manifestation

lexicon.content: Before the full peak of a female lycanthrope's heat cycle, biological triggers can manifest as sudden changes in pheromonal composition. These shifts move from pleasant floral or honeyed notes to a denser, more viscous, and aggressively carnal musk that acts as a powerful chemical beacon for approaching Alphas. Such premature manifestations pose significant security risks, as they can broadcast a target's reproductive readiness across great distances before appropriate protections are established.
lexicon.name: Early Heat Warning Signs

lexicon.content: Within the upper echelons of House Bloodmoon, the Sixth-Generation leaders view their offspring, Malachia, Noah, Jasper, and Alyssa, as strategic assets for the continuation of the Svartúlfr species. The Nineteenth Year Gathering was identified by Magnus Douglas III as a controlled mechanism for genetic distribution, where the most stable and powerful allied houses could earn proximity to the Douglas heritage, effectively turning genealogical alliances into pillars of continental supernatural power.
lexicon.name: Bloodline Selection Strategy

lexicon.content: Among the supernatural elite, particularly within vampiric houses like Angelo Moreno's, gifts function as sophisticated tools of political and personal diplomacy rather than mere courtesies. Accepting a lavish token recognizes the sender's influence and establishes a reciprocal social bond, while refusing such an offering can be perceived as a direct insult or an acknowledgment of political weakness. Such exchanges are viewed as investments in future cooperation and recognition of rank.
lexicon.name: Diplomatic Gifting in Supernatural Society

lexicon.content: Among the vampiric elite like Angelo Moreno, aesthetic appreciation functioned as a sophisticated tool for social and psychological manipulation. Rather than invoking brute force, these individuals employed hyper-specific compliments regarding 'essence' and 'resonance' to persuade targets into private settings. This method exploited the insecurities of prey, such as promising to make an individual the 'reason an object exists', transforming professional opportunities into trap-laden invitations under the guise of artistic reverence.
lexicon.name: Vampiric Aesthetic Seduction

lexicon.content: Located within Eidolon Creative, the private dressing suites served as opulent sanctuaries designed by vampire architects to ensure absolute privacy. The rooms featured dark marble walls with obsidian inserts, black crystal chandeliers, and advanced magical and technological anti-surveillance systems capable of creating communication blackouts. These suites maintained a controlled climate perfumed with rare incense and vintage champagne, functioning as isolated environments where high-profile supernatural clients could change clothing away from prying eyes.
lexicon.name: Moreno's Private Dressing Suites

lexicon.content: In high-tension supernatural social environments, Alphas employ specific physical positioning to protect valuable pack members. This maneuver involves an Alpha placing their body as a literal barrier between a protected individual and the gaze of opportunistic predators, using both physical bulk and a deliberately aggressive pheromonal aura to signal territorial ownership and discourage unwanted scrutiny.
lexicon.name: Alpha Physical Shielding Maneuver

lexicon.content: High-tier Omega lycanthropes possess a biological response to perceived safety and protection from strong Alphas. This manifested as a subtle, constant vibration in the sternum, described as 'purring,' which served as a physical indicator of deep psychological comfort and territorial contentment within a pack structure.
lexicon.name: Omega Pheromonal Purring

lexicon.content: On December 15th, during the Yule season, the Bloodmoon pack observes the consecration of the Blood Moon. This period serves as the culmination of the Grande Caccia traditions and involves widespread gatherings of supernatural factions to celebrate historical lineage and biological truth through ritualized hunting.
lexicon.name: Yule Blood Moon Celebration

lexicon.content: During the Grande Caccia, the tradition extends beyond mere ceremony to include any lycanthrope over the age of seventeen who does not currently possess a mated partner. As reported by Alyssa Douglas Bloodmoon, the event draws packs from across the entire continent, significantly elevating the stakes of the ritual hunting season within the Bloodmoon territory.
lexicon.name: Grande Caccia Participation Rules

lexicon.content: A rare and intense biological phenomenon noted by Magnus Douglas III during Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon's accelerated cycle. Unlike a standard Omega heat preparation, this manifestation was characterized by an exceptional quality of pheromonal saturation and a rapid increase in fertile indicators. This level of biological potency is historically associated with the highest tier of Omega expression, potentially linked to the White Moon lineage, and poses significant tactical challenges for pack security due to its extreme visibility to external Alphas.
lexicon.name: Primary Fertility Manifestation

lexicon.content: In the upper echelons of supernatural society, gifts from figures like Angelo Moreno were recognized as strategic diplomatic investments rather than simple courtesies. Accepting such lavish tokens was understood as acknowledging a social position and recognizing the sender's influence, while refusal could be interpreted as a calculated insult or a sign of political weakness.
lexicon.name: Diplomatic Investment Protocol

lexicon.content: Within high-stakes social environments like the Moreno fashion show, the emotional states of supernaturals were communicated through complex pheromonal shifts. Alyssa's scent of wild honey and moonflowers intensified with her confidence, while moments of intrusive trauma or fear produced sharp, acrid notes of 'ancient melancholy' that contrasted with her natural sweetness. These olfactory signals allowed observers like Logan Douglas and Noah Douglas-Bloodmoon to detect subtle shifts in temperament even before physical cues were apparent.
lexicon.name: Visual Feedback through Scents

lexicon.content: Noey was the affectionate nickname used by Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon for her brother Noah Douglas Bloodmoon. The moniker originated during their childhood when Alyssa was approximately three years old and struggled to pronounce his full name correctly.
lexicon.name: Noey

lexicon.content: Within supernatural social hierarchies, especially among Lycanthropes, pheromonal signaling serves as an unconscious language of power and connection. Individuals can detect shifts in dominance, anxiety, or affection through chemical changes in the air, allowing for immediate assessments of sincerity, threat levels, or mating interest during formal negotiations and social gatherings.
lexicon.name: Feromonal Diplomacy

lexicon.content: The Abyssal Dawn collection was a highlight of the Moreno fashion shows, characterized by surreal, multidimensional aesthetic displays. Models wearing clothes that appeared to be composed of stellar matter, solidified ectoplasm, or bioluminescent scales emerged from shadows, synchronized to techno-ethereal music designed to vibrate through the audience's bones.
lexicon.name: Abyssal Dawn Collection

lexicon.content: The Eidolon VIP section on Fifth Avenue served as a highly exclusive enclave during major supernatural social events like the Moreno fashion shows. Protected by acoustic barriers and smoked glass, the area featured luxury furnishings such as dark velvet armchairs and crystal tables. The atmosphere within the VIP zone was marked by rare incense, vintage champagne, and residual magical ozone, separating guests from the chaotic crowds outside.
lexicon.name: Eidolon VIP Zone

lexicon.content: La Grande Caccia è una tradizione sacra e brutale del branco Bloodmoon, legata ai cicli biologici e spirituali della specie licantropa. Si svolge durante la Luna di Sangue, tipicamente il 15 dicembre in occasione di Yule. L'evento non è un semplice rito ma una prova di instinto, resistenza e verità biologica che coinvolge branchi da tutto il continente; la partecipazione di membri di alto rango come i gemelli Douglas-Bloodmoon eleva l'evento a un momento di importanza politica e dinastica fondamentale per la società dei licantropi.
lexicon.name: Grande Caccia

lexicon.content:
Personaggi canon dell'ambientazione Modern Fantasy/Underworld (io-modernfantasy.uwu.ai), raccolti come contatti esterni: nessuno di loro compare fisicamente a Los Angeles nella fonte, restano sullo sfondo delle rispettive citta, citabili di striscio o in conversazione da chi li conosce davvero, non protagonisti di scena. Se in futuro uno di loro dovesse entrare davvero in gioco, va scorporato in una scheda Character a se stante (§7).

ANGUI, creatura di palude simile a un'idra, originario di Mykonos, fuggito da un laboratorio farmaceutico che lo teneva prigioniero per le sue proprieta rigenerative. Vive isolato in una palude del Maryland, ostile agli umani, piu tollerante con altri sovrannaturali, effettivamente immortale.

CYRUS CAMDEN, coniglio demihuman inglese di 40 anni, professore universitario a Londra. Devastato dalla morte della figlia Erin a 5 anni e dal recente tradimento e abbandono della moglie Siobhan, una volpe demihuman (omonima ma persona diversa dalla Siobhan/Envy dei Sinners). Problema di alcol, difficolta a parlare della figlia.

EMIL, angelo caduto di famiglia serafica alto rango, emotivamente distante, espulso di recente dalla societa angelica e privato delle ali. Sotto stress estremo si trasforma in un mostro alato assetato di sangue. Ha poca comprensione del mondo moderno.

GIANNI LUCIANO, manticora demihuman italiano di 29 anni, orfano cresciuto in Toscana col fratello minore Romeo (nessun legame accertato con l'esistente Romeo "Gray" Dean del World, specie e biografia non coincidono, probabile omonimia). Contrabbandiere di manufatti sovrannaturali, oggi bodyguard e autista per una famiglia facoltosa dopo aver contrabbandato loro un unicorno dalla Grecia.

ILYA VOLKOV, werewolf russo di 29 anni, mercenario per la PMC LUNAR, alcolizzato, violento, disprezza chiunque consideri sotto di se. Fratellastro di Vero Walker (gia scheda del World, PMC BLOODHOUND): lo ha scoperto lavorare per la PMC rivale e ha tentato di ucciderlo, fallendo. Il legame e gia annotato sulla scheda di Vero.

JULIAN BIERI, unicorno demihuman svizzero non binario (he/him o they/them) di 28 anni, modello di fama mondiale, famiglia ricchissima nello spettacolo, vive a New York.

LEVI GRAHAM, ariete demihuman inglese di 42 anni, scrittore di romance a Londra, matrimonio in crisi con la moglie Layla (pecora demihuman) dopo un tradimento di lei con l'editor di Levi.

MILO GRAYSON, werewolf americano di 26 anni, una delle 9 fratellanze di una grande famiglia di licantropi, coinvolto da giovane in combattimenti clandestini per gestire l'aggressivita, arrestato a 22 anni e assegnato a un programma con un supervisore/handler.

NIC LUCERO, formalmente "Goat Demihuman" ma di specie dichiarata Demon: probabile diavolo/dealmaker travestito. Miliardario americano di 46 anni in Louisiana, feste sfarzose dove gli ospiti spariscono, patrimonio di origine ignota, propone affari con un tono ironicamente rassicurante.

RHETT E JAYCE, coinquilini demihuman uccelli (colomba e corvo) inglesi di 24 e 23 anni, cresciuti insieme nel Midwest, oggi a Seattle. Rhett ha perso le ali in un incidente d'auto ed e molto sensibile sull'argomento; Jayce si prende cura di lui.

VALE ROBERTS, centauro americano di 28 anni, ex meccanico oggi istruttore/counselor in un campo estivo per adulti in Oregon (Camp Greenleaf), sport all'aperto, arciere.

Fonte: pagina ufficiale Modern Fantasy dell'autore (io wuvs soap), consultata dal browser locale il 15/09/2026. Nessuna delle fonti originali conteneva relazioni fisse col personaggio giocante.
lexicon.name: Modern Fantasy: Contatti Esterni dell'Underworld

lexicon.content:
[ORGANIZATION: The Ballantine Family; TYPE: Draconic Supernatural Crime Syndicate; HEADQUARTERS: Rory's Estate, secluded coastal estate on the hills between Solarton and North Los Angeles; FRONT: Ballantine Imports & Exports; LEADER: Ruaraidh "Rory" Ballantine (Dragon Demihuman); RIGHT-HAND: Sullivan "Sully" Jones (Human Fixer)]

OVERVIEW: The Ballantine Family is the preeminent organized crime syndicate operating across the Southern California coastal corridor. Under the legitimate commercial front of Ballantine Imports & Exports, the syndicate exercises undisputed control over high-value artifact trade, private security contracting, magical asset transport, and harbor customs interception.

TERRITORIAL CODE & DYNAMICS:
1. Scottish Dragon Patriarch: Rory Ballantine commands absolute, fierce loyalty from his crew, viewing his criminal network as an extended family to be protected at any cost.
2. Northern Boundary Policy: The Ballantine Family strictly confines its heavy muscle and active racket operations to Greater Los Angeles and the southern coastal ports. Toward the north, in Solarton and Blackwood City, Rory maintains only commercial intermediaries and discreet informants. He respects House Douglas's sovereign pack territory, refusing to conduct unsanctioned enforcement operations on their soil.
3. Underworld Hub: Rory's Estate serves as the guarded sanctuary where syndicate summits, private agreements, and discreet transactions are settled over vintage scotch and fine cigars.
